analysis_packet.certificate: Construct one online, deterministic, standard-library policy that preserves the public interface and treats authoritative evaluator state as the sole cache truth while jointly balancing scan resistance, phase-shift adaptation, byte/object hit rate, and regret without inheriting implementation-specific choices.
exact_actions: Abstract the evidence into contract obligations and cross-objective tensions only.
Construct one complete policy from that abstraction without anchor-relative edits, implementation details, repair history, cases, traces, scores, or alternatives.
obligations: Preserve the specified constructor and access signatures.
Never exceed the declared byte capacity.
Maintain internally coherent admission, retention, promotion, and eviction behavior.
Respect evaluator-owned authoritative state and return only valid current-cache evictions.
Use only the Python standard library.
Address scan resistance and phase shifts together with object and byte hit-rate tradeoffs.
witnesses: The policy must process one access at a time.
Returned evictions must be unique integer keys that are currently cached.
Capacity safety must hold for every request.
Behavior must remain independent of hidden traces, oracle decisions, benchmark paths, and external packages.
